episodes.synopsis: Despite insisting that he's fine, Ohma ends up collapsing — and recalls a childhood memory. Then, the Kengan Life-or-Death Tournament kicks off again.
episodes.title: Omen

episodes.synopsis: Takeshi Wakatsuki was raised to be the ultimate fighter for Furumi Pharma, but even he's intimidated by his opponent, Julius Reinhold.
episodes.title: Blast Core

episodes.synopsis: The crowd goes wild when Jun Sekibayashi enters the arena as Marvelous Seki, his legendary pro-wrestler persona.
episodes.title: The Clown

episodes.synopsis: During his match against Muteba, Jun Sekibayashi remembers how his life changed when he began training as a pro wrestler at 15-years-old.
episodes.title: Dignity

episodes.synopsis: Saw Paing is known for his match-ending head-butts, but his lightning-fast opponent Rei Mikazuchi might not let him get close enough to use it.
episodes.title: Suicide Attack

episodes.synopsis: All Setsuna Kiryu wants to do is win this match — and the next two matches — so he can face the man he's been dreaming of: Ohma himself.
episodes.title: An Old Friend

episodes.synopsis: The bout between Setsuna and Gensai Kuroki comes to an end. Ohma remains hospitalized, leaving the Nogi Group with Sen Hatsumi as their only fighter.
episodes.title: Hell

episodes.synopsis: Having survived 45 hanging attempts, death row convict Yohei Bando has a certain physical advantage that he deploys against Sen Hatsumi.
episodes.title: Resurrection

episodes.synopsis: While facing Kaolan Wongsawat, Agito Kanoh begins moving in a strange way; he seems to have developed a brand new fighting style during their match.
episodes.title: Superiority

episodes.synopsis: After the match between Kaolan and Agito, round two of the Kengan Life-or-Death Tournament comes to an end. Suddenly, a change of schedule is announced.
episodes.title: Life and Death

episodes.synopsis: Hayami gives everyone a choice; either join him, or die. When Ohma was a kid in the slums, Niko Tokita trained him the ways of the Niko fighting style.
episodes.title: Rebel Flag

episodes.synopsis: With Ohma still in his hospital room, Hayami and his men attempt to complete their coup — but there might be a traitor foiling their plans.
episodes.title: Melee

episodes.synopsis: Cosmo Imai is told in no uncertain terms that Nishihonji Security Services won't be using him for the next round, but he's still determined to fight.
episodes.title: Headstrong

episodes.synopsis: Familiar with his opponent's every move, the fighter for Nishihonji Security Services is able to keep the match neck-and-neck — but for how long?
episodes.title: Reflecting Water

episodes.synopsis: With special guest Jun Sekibayashi providing ring-side commentary, the next match starts off with an explosive move by Takeshi Wakatsuki.
episodes.title: Ace in the Hole

episodes.synopsis: Rei Mikazuchi steps into the ring to fight for pride, love and desire, but can his Lightning Spirit Style overpower the impregnable Gensai Kuroki?
episodes.title: Culmination

episodes.synopsis: It's Nogi versus Metsudo in the final match of the third round. But before the Floating Cloud can face off with the Fang, Kanoh must defend his position.
episodes.title: Gathering Clouds

episodes.synopsis: As Sen looks back on his past and how he turned down an opportunity to become the next Fang, the fight ramps up and takes a shockingly devastating turn.
episodes.title: The Floating Cloud

episodes.synopsis: On the eve of the final round, Setsuna Kiryu recalls the inhumane treatment he endured on The Inside, and the fateful meeting that saved his life.
episodes.title: Predicament

episodes.synopsis: Ohma finally recovers a crucial memory of who taught him Life Advance, revealing his and Setsuna's complicated pasts.
episodes.title: Demon

episodes.synopsis: With a flurry of powerful Rakshasa's Palm strikes, Setsuna finally gets his wish and faces Ohma in an intense fight that pushes his sanity to the limit.
episodes.title: Farewell

episodes.synopsis: The long-awaited semifinals kick-off and Yamashita receives an ominous visit from Chairman Nogi, who demands the fight be rigged in Furumi Pharma's favor.
episodes.title: Wakatsuki

episodes.synopsis: While Yamashita learns about his surprisingly deep ties to the Kengan Association and Nogi Group, Ohma must find a way to best Wakatsuki in the ring.
episodes.title: Wholehearted

episodes.synopsis: In the highly anticipated second semifinal match, the two massive titans of martial arts, Kuroki and Kanoh, clash in a battle of supreme strength.
episodes.title: Supreme Strength

episodes.synopsis: Pushing each other to their limits, Kuroki and Kanoh continue to evolve their fighting styles. Which of these giants will advance to the finals?
episodes.title: Giant Star

episodes.synopsis: Before their fight, Kuroki unveils the truth behind Niko Style to Ohma. As Ohma prepares to enter the finals, Yamashita gives him one last pep talk.
episodes.title: The Finals

episodes.synopsis: As the intense battle with Kuroki reaches its peak, Ohma waits to unleash Niko Style and Life Advance simultaneously — despite Yamashita's objections.
episodes.title: Victory

episodes.synopsis: Takakaze approaches Chairman Nogi with an unexpected proposal. As life returns to normal for everybody else, Yamashita reflects on his time with "The Ashura."
episodes.title: Finale
